title: TAI owner preflight run discovery
objective: Make owner activation discover the latest completed successful exact-SHA owner-preflight run even when the workflow-list REST payload omits optional repository, branch or event fields, while preserving strict verification of the selected run and all six jobs before mutation.
boundaries: Initial discovery requires exact workflow name, exact SHA, completed success, positive run ID and attempt
Selected run is subsequently verified for repository, branch, exact SHA, attempt, event and owner actors
All six owner-preflight jobs remain mandatory and successful
No image, controller, live acceptance, finalization, rollback or deployment authority is weakened
